about.title: Excellence Guided by Faith.
description: The American Muslim Medical Association (AMMA) fosters professional growth, ethical practice, and community service among Muslim healthcare professionals in the United States.

We provide a unified voice for our members, advocating for health equity, providing mentorship to the next generation, and delivering humanitarian medical relief to those in need, driven by the core Islamic values of compassion and healing.

programs.title: Impactful Programs
programs.description: From local clinics to global missions, AMMA provides structured initiatives that empower our members to make a tangible difference.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions about membership or donations? We've got answers.

questions.question: Who is eligible for membership?
questions.answer: Membership is open to all Muslim healthcare professionals, including physicians, nurses, researchers, and medical students studying in the USA.

questions.question: How are donations utilized?
questions.answer: Donations fund our global medical missions, student scholarships, community health clinics, and operational costs for educational events.

questions.question: Can medical students join?
questions.answer: Yes, we have dedicated student chapters and heavily discounted membership tiers to support your journey.

questions.question: Is AMMA affiliated with specific hospitals?
questions.answer: No, AMMA is an independent professional organization, though our members work in top institutions nationwide.
